security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: http://thumb.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://tile.localhost; worker-src 'self'; frame-src http://*.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.longDescription: A free reader and manager for digital books: a library that follows your folders, readers for EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, PDF, comics and DjVu, annotations, and OCR of scanned books, with every book file only read.
